en.t: So I resolved to go to Yura.

units.source_text: 夏季，那里的海水浴异常热闹，

en.t: In summer, the sea bathing there was exceptionally lively,

units.source_text: 而这季节一定很冷清，谁有陆地和海以灰暗的力量在互相争斗。

en.t: but in this season it must be desolate, with only the land and the sea struggling against each other with a dim, gray force.

units.source_text: 我的脚模糊地记得从西舞鹤到由良约莫是十一二公里的路程。

en.t: My feet vaguely remembered that the road from Nishi-Maizuru to Yura was roughly eleven or twelve kilometers.
